arxiv-2102-09075.title: On the unique ergodicity for a class of 2 dimensional stochastic wave equations
arxiv-2102-09075.creator: Justin Forlano and Leonardo Tolomeo
arxiv-2102-09075.description: Abstract . We study the global-in-time dynamics for a stochastic semilinear wave equation with cubic defocusing nonlinearity and additive noise, posed on the 2 2 -dimensional torus. The noise is taken to be slightly more regular than space-time white noise.

arxiv-2202-06846.title: Polarisation signatures in radio for inclined cosmic-ray induced air-shower identification Journal: Astroparticle Physics
arxiv-2202-06846.creator: Simon Chiche, Kumiko Kotera, Olivier Martineau-Huynh, Matias Tueros, Krijn D. de Vries
arxiv-2202-06846.description: Abstract Autonomous radio-detection, i.e., detection of air-showers with standalone radio arrays, is one of the major technical challenges to overcome for the next generation astroparticle detectors. In this context, we study polarisation signatures of simulated radio signals to perform an identification of the associated air-showers initiated by cosmic-rays and neutrinos.

arxiv-2212-14028.title: Emergent phenomena in QCD:
arxiv-2212-14028.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . A basic understanding of the relevant features of hadron properties from first principles QCD has remained elusive, and should be understood as emergent phenomena which depend critically on the number of dimensions of physical spacetime. These properties include the mechanism of color confinement, the origin of the hadron mass scale, chiral symmetry breaking and the pattern of hadronic bound states.

arxiv-2302-14769.title: Membership Inference Attack for Beluga Whales Discrimination
arxiv-2302-14769.creator: Voncarlos M. Araújo Sébastien Gambs Clément Chion, Robert Michaud Léo Schneider Hadrien Lautraite
arxiv-2302-14769.description: Abstract To efficiently monitor the growth and evolution of a particular wildlife population, one of the main fundamental challenges to address in animal ecology is the re-identification of individuals that have been previously encountered but also the discrimination between known and unknown individuals (the so-called “open-set problem”), which is the first step to realize before re-identification.

arxiv-2307-06998.title: Iso-entangled bases and joint measurements
arxiv-2307-06998.creator: Flavio Del Santo, Jakub Czartowski, Karol Życzkowski, Nicolas Gisin
arxiv-2307-06998.description: Abstract While entanglement between distant parties has been extensively studied, entangled measurements have received relatively little attention despite their significance in understanding non-locality and their central role in quantum computation and networks. We present a systematic study of entangled measurements, providing a complete classification of all equivalence classes of iso-entangled bases for projective joint measurements on 2 qubits.

arxiv-2412-13966.title: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning-Based Imputation Techniques for Air Quality Datasets with High Missing Data Rates Thanks: S. Yan, N.E. O’Connor, and M. Liu are with the School of Electronic Engineering and Insight Research Ireland Centre for Data Analytics at Dublin City University, Dublin,
arxiv-2412-13966.creator: Sen Yan, Graduate Student Member, IEEE, David J. O’Connor, Xiaojun Wang
arxiv-2412-13966.description: Abstract Urban pollution poses serious health risks, particularly in relation to traffic-related air pollution, which remains a major concern in many cities. Vehicle emissions contribute to respiratory and cardiovascular issues, especially for vulnerable and exposed road users like pedestrians and cyclists. Therefore, accurate air quality monitoring with high spatial resolution is vital for good urban environmental management.

arxiv-2504-07574.title: Malware analysis assisted by AI with R2AI
arxiv-2504-07574.creator: Axelle Apvrille, Daniel Nakov
arxiv-2504-07574.description: Abstract 1 Abstract This research studies the quality, speed and cost of malware analysis assisted by artificial intelligence. It focuses on Linux and IoT malware of 2024-2025, and uses r2ai, the AI extension of Radare2’s disassembler. Not all malware and not all LLMs are equivalent but the study shows excellent results with Claude 3.5 and 3.7 Sonnet.

arxiv-2509-18827.title: Elliptical Polarization in Partial Wave Analysis of Two Spinless Meson Photoproduction
arxiv-2509-18827.creator: D. I. Glazier, V. Mathieu
arxiv-2509-18827.description: Abstract Mathematical ambiguities in partial-wave analysis present a significant challenge to the extraction of resonance properties in hadronic reactions. Recent work has shown that while linear photon polarization can resolve continuous ambiguities in the photoproduction of two pseudoscalar mesons, a final complex conjugate ambiguity remains. In this work, we extend the partial-wave formalism to include circular and elliptical photon polarization.

arxiv-2509-23766.title: Embedding calculus and Vassiliev spectral sequence
arxiv-2509-23766.creator: Syunji Moriya
arxiv-2509-23766.description: Abstract . Vassiliev spectral sequence and Sinha spectral sequence are both related to cohomology of the space of long knots ℝ → ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}^{3} . Although they have different origins, the Vassiliev E 1 E_{1} -page and the Sinha E 2 E_{2} -page are isomorphic (up to a degree shift).

pmc-10560171.title: Essential oil extracted from Quzhou Aurantii Fructus prevents acute liver failure through inhibiting lipopolysaccharide-mediated inflammatory response
pmc-10560171.creator: Tian Lan, Wen Wang, De-Lian Huang, Xi-Xi Zeng, Xiao-Xiao Wang, Jian Wang, Yu-Hua Tong, Zhu-Jun Mao, Si-Wei Wang
pmc-10560171.description: Quzhou Aurantii Fructus (QAF) has a long history as a folk medicine and food for the treatment of liver diseases. While our earlier study provided evidence of hepatoprotective properties contained within the flavonoids and limonins constituents in QAF, the potential preventative effects afforded by essential oil components present within QAF remains enigmatic.

pmc-11618392.title: Bispecific antibodies targeting BCMA or GPRC5D are highly effective in relapsed myeloma after CAR T-cell therapy
pmc-11618392.creator: Maximilian Merz, Danai Dima, Hamza Hashmi, Nausheen Ahmed, Friedrich Stölzel, Tobias A. W. Holderried, Roland Fenk, Fabian Müller, Natalia Tovar, Aina Oliver-Cáldes, Kristin Rathje, James A. Davis, David Fandrei, Vladan Vucinic, Soraya Kharboutli, Ben-Niklas Baermann, Francis Ayuk, Uwe Platzbecker,
pmc-11618392.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Despite the astonishing outcomes after chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy for relapsed refractory multiple myeloma (RRMM), most patients eventually relapse. There are only limited data available on salvage therapies following relapse after BCMA-directed CAR T-cell therapy.

pmc-12564689.title: Computational Analysis of Electron-Donating and Withdrawing Effects on Asymmetric Viologens for Enhanced Electrochromic Performance
pmc-12564689.creator: Gulzat Nuroldayeva, Mannix P. Balanay
pmc-12564689.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Viologens are promising candidates for next-generation electrochromic devices due to their reversible color changes, low operating voltages, and structural tunability. However, their practical performance is often constrained by limited color range, stability issues, and poor charge delocalization. In this study, we present a detailed density functional theory (DFT) and time-dependent DFT (TD-DFT) investigation of asymmetric viologens based on the Benzyl-4,4′-dipyridyl-R (BnV-R) framework.

pmc-12567345.title: Development of Bio-Based Benzoxazine V-fa/PEG/Carbon Black Composites: Thermal and Mechanical Properties
pmc-12567345.creator: Nattapon Chaiwichian, Chaitawat Saelee, Kamontip Kuttiyawong, Sarawut Rimdusit, Kasinee Hemvichian, Pattra Lertsarawut, Sunan Tiptipakorn
pmc-12567345.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In this study, the blends of bio-based polybenzoxazine (V-fa type) and poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG) with PEG contents from 50 to 95 wt% and different molecular weights were developed to improve the flexibility of thermosetting polymers. Of these blends, PEG 8k at 80 wt%, which exhibited the best processability, was selected for further development via compositing with carbon black (CB) from 0 to 20 phr.

pmc-12950093.title: Dietary behavior and its association with sleep-disordered breathing symptoms in Taiwanese children
pmc-12950093.creator: Hai-Hua Chuang, Ruei-Shan Hu, Wan-Ni Lin, Li-Jen Hsin, Tuan-Jen Fang, Hsueh-Yu Li, Li-Ang Lee
pmc-12950093.description: BackgroundSleep-disordered breathing (SDB) is highly prevalent in children and is associated with significant cognitive, metabolic, and quality-of-life (QOL) impairments. While obesity is a primary risk factor, the role of specific dietary behaviors as independent, modifiable contributors to SDB symptom severity remains underexplored.

The International Alliance for the Control of Scabies criteria were used to diagnose scabies. Overall, the prevalence was (40.35%; 159/394).
